meaning_in_line: enduring and long-lasting alongside heaven and earth across ten thousand ages (天地と長く久しく)
person_quality: timeless, enduring constancy that stays true across decades without ever fading
line_original: 天地と 長く久しく 万代に 変らずあらむ 行幸の宮
source: 『万葉集 (鹿持雅澄訓訂)』巻第三・315 大伴旅人（奈良時代）

reading: ヘイ・ビョウ・たいらか (hei · byō · tairaka)
meaning_in_line: in peaceful safety, calm health, and unruffled well-being (平らけく)
person_quality: peaceful, grounding equanimity (平らか) that keeps the household calm and safe through every journey
line_original: あり巡り我が来るまでに平らけく親はいまさね恙無く妻は待たせと住吉の我が皇神に幣奉り祈り申して
source: 『万葉集 (鹿持雅澄訓訂)』巻第二十・4408 大伴家持（奈良時代）

meaning_in_line: pure, crystal-clear, and refreshing to the soul (川の瀬の浄きを見れば)
person_quality: unsullied, crystal-clear integrity of heart that refreshes everyone who encounters it
line_original: あしひきの み山も清に 落ち激つ 芳野の川の 川の瀬の 浄きを見れば 上辺には 千鳥数鳴き 下辺には かはづ妻呼ぶ
source: 『万葉集 (鹿持雅澄訓訂)』巻第六・920 笠金村（奈良時代）

reading: セイ・ととのえる・ととのう (sei · totonoeru · totonou)
meaning_in_line: to bring people and things into harmonious, cared-for order (撫で賜ひ整へ賜ひ)
person_quality: calm, attentive orderliness that brings harmony, care, and readiness to any home or team
line_original: もののふの 八十伴男を 撫で賜ひ 整へ賜ひ 食す国の 四方の人をも あぶさはず 恵み賜へば
source: 『万葉集 (鹿持雅澄訓訂)』巻第十九・4254 大伴家持（奈良時代）

meaning_in_line: to revere and hold in the highest esteem an honest, unpretentious nobility of character (尤尊ぶべし)
person_quality: quiet, unpretentious nobility of spirit that commands deep respect without ever seeking display
fits_relationships: parent / mentor / partner / friend / work / memorial
line_original: 剛毅木訥の仁に近きたぐひ氣稟の淸質尤尊ぶべし
source: 松尾芭蕉『おくのほそ道』仏五左衛門・日光（江戸時代）

meaning_in_line: peaceful, tranquil, and secure in daily life beneath benevolent light (國民安堵の栖穩かなり)
person_quality: serene, reassuring presence (穏やか) that makes home and daily life feel safe, calm, and peaceful
line_original: 今此御光一天にかゞやきて恩澤八荒にあふれ國民安堵の栖穩かなり
source: 松尾芭蕉『おくのほそ道』日光（江戸時代）

meaning_in_line: to illuminate radiantly like the morning sun shining on vermilion walls (朝日朱の玉垣を輝かす)
person_quality: morning-sun radiance that brightens everyone around them and brings out the brilliance in their surroundings
fits_relationships: partner / child / friend / mentor / parent / work
line_original: 宮ばしらふとしく彩椽きらびやかに石の階九仭にかさなり朝日朱の玉垣を輝かす
source: 松尾芭蕉『おくのほそ道』塩竈（江戸時代）

meaning_in_line: to rejoice wholeheartedly in sharing a journey and caring for a companion's hardships (ともにせん事を悅び)
person_quality: warm, companionable joy that delights in walking alongside others and sharing both beauty and hardship
line_original: このたび松島象潟の眺めともにせん事を悅びかつは羈旅の難をいたはらんと旅立曉髪を剃て墨染にさまをかえ惣五を改て宗悟とす
source: 松尾芭蕉『おくのほそ道』黒羽・曾良（江戸時代）

reading: ユウ・やさしい・すぐれる (yū · yasashii · sugureru)
meaning_in_line: deeply gentle, refined, and full of tender human feeling (優に情ありける)
person_quality: tender, empathetic gentleness (優しい・優美) that honors human feelings without judgment
fits_relationships: parent / partner / friend / mentor / child / memorial
line_original: 法顯三藏の天竺に渡りて、故郷の扇を見ては悲しび、病に臥しては漢の食を願ひ給ひける事を聞きて、「さばかりの人の、無下にこそ、心弱き氣色を、人の國にて見え給ひけれ。」と人のいひしに、弘融僧都、「優に情ありける三藏かな。」といひたりしこそ、法師の樣にもあらず、心にくく覺えしか。
source: 吉田兼好『徒然草 (校註日本文學大系)』第八十四段（鎌倉・南北朝時代）

meaning_in_line: to look back upon and cherish the noble character of a revered teacher with fond longing (彼見佛聖の寺はいづくにやと慕はる)
person_quality: warm, magnetic virtue that others naturally look up to, cherish, and hold dear in their hearts
line_original: 雲居禪師の德化によりて七堂いから改りて金壁壯嚴光かゝやき佛土成就の大伽藍とはなれりける彼見佛聖の寺はいづくにやと慕はる
source: 松尾芭蕉『おくのほそ道』瑞巌寺（江戸時代）

meaning_in_line: a true friend of generous heart, healing care, and wisdom (善き友三つあり)
person_quality: true, life-enriching companionship that gives generously, heals, and shares wisdom
line_original: 善き友三つあり。一にはものくるゝ友、二には醫師、三には智惠ある友。
source: 吉田兼好『徒然草 (校註日本文學大系)』第百十七段（鎌倉・南北朝時代）

meaning_in_line: to nurture life and help others in fulfilment of loyalty and filial devotion (身を養ひ人を助け)
person_quality: practical, compassionate help that sustains others and fulfills love through concrete action
line_original: 次に醫術を習ふべし。身を養ひ人を助け、忠孝のつとめも、醫にあらずばあるべからず。
source: 吉田兼好『徒然草 (校註日本文學大系)』第百二十二段（鎌倉・南北朝時代）

meaning_in_line: to be conscientious, humble, and unpretentiously mindful in all one's conduct (愚かにして謹めるは得の本なり)
person_quality: humble, conscientious mindfulness that never cuts corners and forms the true root of excellence
line_original: 萬の道の人、たとひ不堪なりといへども、堪能の非家の人にならぶ時、必ずまさることは、たゆみなく愼みて輕々しくせぬと、偏に自由なるとの等しからぬなり。藝能所作のみにあらず、大方の振舞、心づかひも、愚かにして謹めるは得の本なり、巧みにしてほしきまゝなるは失の本なり。
source: 吉田兼好『徒然草 (校註日本文學大系)』第百八十七段（鎌倉・南北朝時代）

meaning_in_line: wise and noble in heart, continually growing from wisdom to greater wisdom (心はなどか、賢きより賢きにも、うつさば移らざらむ)
person_quality: ever-deepening wisdom of heart that grows through reflection and humility rather than outward show
line_original: 人品容貌こそ生れつきたらめ、心はなどか、賢きより賢きにも、うつさば移らざらむ。
source: 吉田兼好『徒然草 (校註日本文學大系)』第一段（鎌倉・南北朝時代）

meaning_in_line: at peace and unburdened in heart (身を閑にし、事に與らずして心を安くせむこそ)
person_quality: serene, reassuring peace of heart (安らか・安心) that puts everyone around them at ease
line_original: いまだ誠の道を知らずとも、縁を離れて身を閑にし、事に與らずして心を安くせむこそ、暫く樂しぶともいひつべけれ。
source: 吉田兼好『徒然草 (校註日本文學大系)』第七十五段（鎌倉・南北朝時代）

meaning_in_line: to pledge evergreen constancy with the pine and cypress that never wither in frost (契松柏之後凋)
person_quality: unbreakable promise and kindred bond (契り) that stays evergreen through every frost and season
line_original: 嵐陰欲暮。契松柏之後凋。
source: 『和漢朗詠集』巻上・秋・菊 紀長谷雄（平安時代）

meaning_in_line: to treasure and hold dear every moment of spring and youth shared with a companion (踏花同惜少年春)
person_quality: tender, appreciative heart (惜しむ・愛惜) that never takes a single shared moment or person for granted
line_original: 背燭共憐深夜月。踏花同惜少年春。
source: 『和漢朗詠集』巻上・春・春夜 白居易「春中与盧四周諒華陽観同居」（唐・平安撰）

meaning_in_line: to warmly invite, encourage, and host companions like the spring breeze (樽前勧酔是春風)
person_quality: warm, encouraging hospitality that lifts others' spirits as naturally as the spring breeze
line_original: 花下忘帰因美景。樽前勧酔是春風。
source: 『和漢朗詠集』巻上・春・春興 白居易「菩提寺上方晩眺」（唐・平安撰）

meaning_in_line: to polish and make gems sparkle in the sunlight and breeze (瑩日瑩風)
person_quality: luminous, gem-like clarity that polishes every work and shines brightly in the sun and wind
line_original: 瑩日瑩風。高低千顆万顆之玉。染枝染浪。表裏一入再入之紅。
source: 『和漢朗詠集』巻上・春・花 菅原文時（平安時代）

meaning_in_line: to pass down and hear across generations the memory of compassionate wisdom (ほのかに傳へ聞くに)
person_quality: faithful transmission of wisdom, kindness, and cultural memory from one generation to the next
line_original: ほのかに傳へ聞くに、いにしへのかしこき御代には、あはれみをもて國ををさめ給ふ。…これ民をめぐみ、世をたすけ給ふによりてなり。
source: 鴨長明『方丈記』（國文大觀本・鎌倉時代）

reading: セイ・ジョウ・さかん・もる (sei · jō · sakan · moru)
meaning_in_line: to flourish in full, vibrant prime like the capital in spring (咲く花の薫ふがごとく今盛りなり)
person_quality: vibrant, generous energy that brings every gathering and endeavor into full, fragrant bloom
line_original: あをによし寧楽の京師は咲く花の薫ふがごとく今盛りなり
source: 『万葉集 (鹿持雅澄訓訂)』巻第三・328 小野老（奈良時代）

reading: ケン・ゲン・しるし (ken · gen · shirushi)
meaning_in_line: living proof and joyful fulfillment of being alive in a flourishing age (生ける験あり)
person_quality: living proof (生けるしるし) that makes every effort and year of life feel deeply worthwhile
fits_relationships: parent / partner / mentor / friend / work / memorial
line_original: 御民吾生ける験あり天地の栄ゆる時に遭へらく思へば
source: 『万葉集 (鹿持雅澄訓訂)』巻第六・996 海犬養宿禰岡麻呂（奈良時代）

meaning_in_line: to shine and gleam like a precious gem hidden among the rocks (石隠り燿ふ玉)
person_quality: inner brilliance that gleams quietly like a gem even when not seeking the spotlight
line_original: 見渡せば近きものから石隠り燿ふ玉を取らずはやまじ
source: 『万葉集 (鹿持雅澄訓訂)』巻第六・951 笠金村（奈良時代）

meaning_in_line: to rejoice wholeheartedly upon reading a cherished friend's words (耽読吟諷し、感謝歓怡す)
person_quality: wholehearted, welcoming delight (歓び) that rejoices in another person's voice and presence
line_original: 耽読吟諷し、感謝歓怡す。宜主を恋ふ誠、誠に犬馬に逾ゆ。徳を仰ぐ心、心葵カクに同じ。
source: 『万葉集 (鹿持雅澄訓訂)』巻第五・吉田連宜書簡（奈良時代）

reading: イ・よろこぶ・やわらぐ (i · yorokobu · yawaragu)
meaning_in_line: to rejoice with serene, harmonious gladness of heart (耽読吟諷し、感謝歓怡す)
person_quality: serene, gentle cheerfulness (怡び・和らぎよろこぶ) that warms family and friends
line_original: 耽読吟諷し、感謝歓怡す。
source: 『万葉集 (鹿持雅澄訓訂)』巻第五・吉田連宜書簡（奈良時代）

meaning_in_line: graceful, lovely, and radiant in bearing (繪に書きたるやうに美くしげにて居させ給へるに)
person_quality: inner and outer grace (美しさ) that brings harmony and dignity to every moment
line_original: しげいしやの繪に書きたるやうに美くしげにて居させ給へるに、宮いとやすらかに今すこしおとなびさせ給へる御けしきの紅の御ぞに匂ひ合せ給ひて、なほたぐひはいかでかと見えさせ給ふ。
source: 清少納言『枕草子』（國文大觀本）「淑景舎、東宮にまゐり給ふほどのことなど」（平安時代）

reading: カン・しずか・ひま (kan · shizuka · hima)
meaning_in_line: serenely unhurried and free from worldly clamor (縁を離れて身を閑にし)
person_quality: tranquil, unhurried poise (閑か・のどか) that creates a peaceful sanctuary away from the world's rush
line_original: いまだ誠の道を知らずとも、縁を離れて身を閑にし、事に與らずして心を安くせむこそ、暫く樂しぶともいひつべけれ。
source: 吉田兼好『徒然草 (校註日本文學大系)』第七十五段（鎌倉・南北朝時代）

reading: シュウ・シュ・おさめる (shū · shu · osameru)
meaning_in_line: to cultivate and refine one's own character with sincerity of heart (欲齊其家者，先修其身)
person_quality: quiet, lifelong self-cultivation that leads family and colleagues by personal example
line_original: 欲齊其家者，先修其身；欲修其身者，先正其心；欲正其心者，先誠其意。
source: 『禮記』大學（先秦・秦漢）

reading: セイ・ショウ・ただしい (sei · shō · tadashii)
meaning_in_line: to set one's heart straight and true in sincerity (欲修其身者，先正其心)
person_quality: unwavering fairness and uprightness of heart that serves as a moral compass for others
line_original: 欲修其身者，先正其心；欲正其心者，先誠其意。
source: 『禮記』大學（先秦・秦漢）

reading: ソ・ス・もと (so · su · moto)
meaning_in_line: unadorned, pure white silk; beholding and keeping one's natural, unpretentious self (見素抱樸)
person_quality: unadorned, natural honesty (素直・素朴) that shines without pretense or artifice
line_original: 見素抱樸，少私寡欲。
source: 『老子』道德經・第十九章（唐玄宗御註本・先秦）

meaning_in_line: pure-hearted, kind, and genuinely good in disposition (夫子溫、良、恭、儉、讓以得之)
person_quality: innate, unforced goodness and kindness of heart (善良・良さ) that everyone immediately trusts
fits_relationships: parent / partner / friend / mentor / child / work
line_original: 夫子溫、良、恭、儉、讓以得之。夫子之求之也，其諸異乎人之求之與！
source: 『論語』學而第一（先秦）

reading: キョウ・うやうやしい (kyō · uyauyashii)
meaning_in_line: courteous, reverent, and considerate in every interaction with others (與人恭而有禮)
person_quality: warm, attentive courtesy (うやうやしい・礼儀正しい) that treats every person with dignity and makes them feel like family
line_original: 君子敬而無失，與人恭而有禮，四海之內，皆兄弟也。
source: 『論語』顏淵第十二（先秦）

meaning_in_line: humble, deferential, and generously yielding credit and place to others (溫、良、恭、儉、讓)
person_quality: unselfish modesty (譲る・謙譲) that quietly steps back to let others shine
line_original: 夫子溫、良、恭、儉、讓以得之。夫子之求之也，其諸異乎人之求之與！
source: 『論語』學而第一（先秦）

reading: ホ・フ・たすける (ho · fu · tasukeru)
meaning_in_line: to support, assist, and strengthen one another's benevolence through friendship (以友輔仁)
person_quality: steadfast, uplifting support (輔ける) that walks beside a friend or partner and brings out their best
line_original: 曾子曰：「君子以文會友，以友輔仁。」
source: 『論語』顏淵第十二（先秦）

reading: セイ・ジョウ・なる・なす (sei · jō · naru · nasu)
meaning_in_line: to help others fulfill and bring to fruition their finest qualities (君子成人之美)
person_quality: generous mentorship and encouragement that helps others achieve their dreams and bring out their best
line_original: 子曰：「君子成人之美，不成人之惡。小人反是。」
source: 『論語』顏淵第十二（先秦）

meaning_in_line: humble modesty—holding a mountain's height quietly within the earth—that gives fairly to all (地中有山，謙)
person_quality: deep, mountain-within-the-earth humility that carries great capability without a trace of pride
line_original: 謙：地中有山，謙；君子以裒多益寡，稱物平施。
source: 『周易』大象・謙卦（先秦）

reading: ジュン・したがう (jun · shitagau)
meaning_in_line: gentle, steady cultivation of virtue that grows from small beginnings to great height like a tree rising from the earth (君子以順德，積小以高大)
person_quality: gentle, unforced steadiness that accumulates small daily acts of kindness into something tall and enduring
line_original: 升：地中生木，升；君子以順德，積小以高大。
source: 『周易』大象・升卦（先秦）

reading: ショウ・あきらか (shō · akiraka)
meaning_in_line: to shine forth and illuminate radiant virtue like the sun rising above the earth (君子以自昭明德)
person_quality: sunrise clarity and open-hearted integrity that illuminates the path for others
line_original: 晉：明出地上，晉；君子以自昭明德。
source: 『周易』大象・晉卦（先秦）

meaning_in_line: to practice, learn, and discuss together with friends like two lakes nourishing each other (君子以朋友講習)
person_quality: lifelong joy in learning and practicing alongside friends, mutually enriching one another
line_original: 兌：麗澤，兌；君子以朋友講習。
source: 『周易』大象・兌卦（先秦）

reading: シン・おや・したしい (shin · oya · shitashii)
meaning_in_line: to feel warm closeness and affection toward one's teacher and companions (安其學而親其師)
person_quality: warm, approachable kindness (親しみ・親切) that makes students, colleagues, and family feel immediately close and cared for
line_original: 安其學而親其師，樂其友而信其道，是以雖離師輔而不反也。
source: 『禮記』學記（先秦・秦漢）

meaning_in_line: to nurture and help another person's good qualities grow (教也者，長善而救其失者也)
person_quality: patient mentorship that spots what is good in another person and helps it grow tall
line_original: 知其心，然後能救其失也。教也者，長善而救其失者也。
source: 『禮記』學記（先秦・秦漢）

meaning_in_line: to respond to a simple gift with precious jade—not merely to repay, but to seal an everlasting friendship (報之以瓊瑤，匪報也，永以為好也)
person_quality: wholehearted gratitude (報いる・恩返し) that answers every kindness with tenfold warmth and lasting affection
line_original: 投我以木桃，報之以瓊瑤，匪報也，永以為好也。
source: 『詩經』衛風・木瓜（先秦）

reading: コウ・すき・このむ (kō · suki · konomu)
meaning_in_line: enduring affection, harmony, and cherished friendship forever (永以為好也)
person_quality: warm, enduring affection (好意・よしみ) that treasures a bond for a lifetime
line_original: 投我以木瓜，報之以瓊琚，匪報也，永以為好也。
source: 『詩經』衛風・木瓜（先秦）

meaning_in_line: to treasure and hold someone dear in the very center of one's heart, never forgetting them for a single day (中心藏之，何日忘之)
person_quality: deep, quiet devotion that holds a cherished person in the center of the heart through every day and year
line_original: 心乎愛矣，遐不謂矣？中心藏之，何日忘之？
source: 『詩經』小雅・隰桑（先秦）

meaning_in_line: to bring warm harmony, peace, and blessing to one's home and family (宜其室家)
person_quality: warm, harmonizing presence that makes a home and family flourish in peace and affection
line_original: 桃之夭夭，灼灼其華，之子于歸，宜其室家。
source: 『詩經』周南・桃夭（先秦）

reading: タン・ジン・たたえる (tan · jin · tataeru)
meaning_in_line: deep, brimming, and lasting in harmonious joy (和樂且湛)
person_quality: deep, quiet fullness of spirit (湛える) that holds joy, wisdom, and warmth like deep clear water
line_original: 我有嘉賓，鼓瑟鼓琴。鼓瑟鼓琴，和樂且湛。
source: 『詩經』小雅・鹿鳴（先秦）

meaning_in_line: unshakeably firm and resilient through a thousand trials and winds from every direction (千磨萬擊還堅勁)
person_quality: unshakeable, bamboo-like resilience and reliability that stands firm through every storm
line_original: 咬定青山不放鬆，立根原在破巖中。千磨萬擊還堅勁，任爾東西南北風。
source: 鄭燮「竹石」清

meaning_in_line: deeper than a thousand-foot peach-blossom pool in friendship and affection (桃花潭水深千尺，不及汪倫送我情)
person_quality: deep, bottomless warmth of heart and thoughtfulness whose affection outmeasures any words
line_original: 桃花潭水深千尺，不及汪倫送我情。
source: 李白「贈汪倫」唐

meaning_in_line: to share the same luminous moon together across a thousand miles (但願人長久，千里共嬋娟)
person_quality: wholehearted togetherness (共にする・分かち合う) that shares life's joys and stays connected across any distance
line_original: 但願人長久，千里共嬋娟。
